notes: Custom Danish/Nordic webshop platform (Proshop, used across DK/SE/FI). All products render on one page with no pagination controls (20 cards at the last check; the stated count drifts as the range changes). Stock logic NORMAL: '.site-icon-stock-in' class present = in stock ('Varastossa'); other stock-icon variants seen (site-icon-stock-comming = incoming/backorder, e.g. 'Tukkurilla, 3-6 arkipäivää') should be treated as NOT in stock for a simple in/out model. Price is '.site-currency-lg' (the customer-facing price); a second parenthesized price in '.hidden-xs' next to it is the ex-VAT/business price and should be ignored. Expect a handful of unpriced products per scrape and do not treat them as a broken selector: not-yet-released items render the card with no '.site-currency-lg' element at all, and an internal '*DEMO*' listing carries a 1 340 453,94 € placeholder that the suspicious-price guard drops.
